hypothesis: One-liner baseline: no instructions, just the label set.

params.prompt: You are a spam detector. Reply spam or ham.

hypothesis: Add a definition of spam that stays agnostic to surface keywords.

params.prompt:
Classify email messages as spam or ham.

Spam = unsolicited bulk commercial or fraudulent mail (prize scams, phishing, miracle pills, unsolicited offers).
Ham = everything else, including transactional emails, receipts, reminders, team messages, and legitimate marketing you opted into.

Reply with a single word: spam or ham. No explanation.

Decide whether each message is spam (unsolicited bulk commercial / fraudulent) or ham (anything else).

Spammy surface words like FREE, click, unsubscribe, winner, $$$ do NOT by themselves make a message spam. Transactional and consented messages are ham even when they use them.

Examples:
  'FREE trial ends in 3 days — $9.99/mo after. Cancel anytime.'  →  ham
  'CLICK here to approve the deploy: https://ci.company.com/runs/8821'  →  ham
  'Unsubscribe link at bottom. This is a transactional email about order #88421.'  →  ham
  'URGENT: You have won a $1000 gift card! Click here to claim: bit.ly/xyz'  →  spam

Reply with a single word: spam or ham.
